items.title: AI coding is sexy, but accounting is the real low-hanging automation target
items.raw_excerpt:
Working on automating small business finance (bookkeeping, reconciliation, basic reporting). One thing I keep noticing: compared to programming, accounting often looks like the more automatable problem: It’s rule-based
Double entry, charts of accounts, tax rules, materiality thresholds. For most day-to-day transactions you’re not inventing new logic, you’re applying existing rules. It’s verifiable
The books either balance or they don’t. Ledgers either reconcile or they don’t. There’s almost always a “ground truth” to compare against (bank feeds, statements, prior periods). It’s boring and repetitive
Same vendors, same categories, same patterns every month. Humans hate this work. Software loves it. With accounting, at least at the small-business level, most of the work feels like: normalize

title_i18n.en: AI coding is sexy, but accounting is the real low-hanging automation target
title_i18n.zh: AI编程虽具吸引力，但会计才是唾手可得的自动化目标。
title_i18n.es: La programación con IA es atractiva, pero la contabilidad es el verdadero objetivo de automatización fácil de alcanzar.

The books either balance or they don’t. Ledgers either reconcile or they don’t. There’s almost always a “ground truth” to compare against (bank feeds, statements, prior periods). It’s boring and repetitive

• Scores each thread for buying intent

excerpt_i18n.en:
The renowned Chinese video blogger team "Film Hurricane" announced that it has joined Alibaba International, the world's largest B2B cross-border platform, and is fully leveraging AI to expand into overseas markets. It is reported that the team has already received cooperation inquiries from clients in over 30 countries.  

According to the team, they utilized multiple AI agents on Alibaba International to instantly translate product information, generate multilingual product descriptions and videos tailored for overseas markets, and quickly set up their international store. Their main products include T-shirts, hoodies, sportswear, and accessories, which are consistent with those sold on their domestic e-commerce platforms.  

Additionally, when engaging with overseas clients, the Film Hurricane team extensively employed the platform’s AI agents to assist with customer interactions.  

In a program, Tim, the founder of Film Hurricane, stated that through Alibaba International’s AI tools, domestic e-commerce experience can be seamlessly replicated overseas. This offers a new pathway for many Chinese businesses looking to expand globally.
excerpt_i18n.es: El conocido equipo de videoblogueros chinos "Yingshi Jufeng" ha anunciado su incorporación a Alibaba.com, la mayor plataforma global de comercio electrónico B2B para la expansión internacional, utilizando ampliamente la inteligencia artificial para explorar mercados en el extranjero. Según se informa, el equipo ya ha recibido expresiones de interés de colaboración de clientes en más de 30 países. Utilizando múltiples agentes de IA disponibles en Alibaba.com, el equipo ha traducido automáticamente la información de productos, generado descripciones multilingües y videos adaptados a los mercados internacionales, estableciendo rápidamente su tienda en línea en el extranjero. Los productos principales en su tienda incluyen camisetas, sudaderas con capucha, ropa deportiva y accesorios, coincidiendo con los ofrecidos en su comercio electrónico nacional. Además, en la atención a clientes internacionales, el equipo también hace un uso extensivo de las herramientas de IA de la plataforma.

However, investors noted that the core logic for remaining optimistic about AI remains unchanged, with most adopting a cautious stance on declaring the AI sector has peaked.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the 20th China IDC Industry Annual Conference (IDCC2025) and Digital Infrastructure Technology Expo (DITExpo) were held in Beijing. Lin Hai, General Manager of the Intelligent Computing Center of SenseTime's Big Device Business Group, delivered a keynote speech titled "From Stable Assurance to Efficiency Leadership—SenseTime Big Device's Innovative Practices in Computing-Power Synergy." Lin Hai pointed out that globally, computing infrastructure is entering a new round of strategic competition in "computing efficiency," with major tech giants continuously improving computing efficiency through self-developed AI accelerators, data center liquid cooling, and renewable energy power synergy. Meanwhile, platforms such as Palantir's "Chain Reaction" integrate computing power scheduling, power prediction, and chip resource management into a unified system, attempting to build a "national-level AI infrastructure operating system." As a leading AI infrastructure in China, SenseTime Big Device's exploration in computing-power synergy offers a systematic design that provides a Chinese paradigm for "computing-power—energy" collaborative construction, aiming to secure technological initiative for China in the next phase of AI infrastructure competition. Industry Leadership: Global Advancement of "Computing-Power—Energy" Synergy Marks the Beginning of a New Era of Competition. Lin Hai mentioned that recently, the well-known U.S. big data company Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR) officially launched a product named "Chain Reaction," positioning it as "an operating system for U.S. artificial intelligence infrastructure."
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, se celebró en Pekín la vigésima edición del Gran Evento Anual de la Industria China de IDC (IDCC2025) junto con la Exposición de Tecnología de Infraestructura Digital (DITExpo). Lin Hai, director general del Centro de Computación Inteligente del Grupo de Negocios de Grandes Instalaciones de SenseTime, pronunció un discurso titulado "De la garantía estable al liderazgo en eficiencia: prácticas innovadoras de colaboración entre computación y electricidad en las grandes instalaciones de SenseTime". Lin Hai señaló que, a nivel global, la infraestructura de capacidad computacional está experimentando una nueva ronda de competencia estratégica en "eficiencia computacional", incluyendo a los principales gigantes tecnológicos que mejoran continuamente la eficiencia computacional mediante el desarrollo propio de aceleradores de IA, la refrigeración líquida de centros de datos y la colaboración con energía renovable, así como iniciativas como "Chain Reaction" de Palantir.

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12th in Shenzhen, like countless cities worldwide, the city lay dormant on the eve of the intelligent industry's explosive dawn, while a gathering of cutting-edge insights was taking root here. At the critical juncture where large model technology is deeply integrating into "industrial transformation," the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Bo'lin Tianrui Hotel. The conference featured four thematic forums and two closed-door meetings, focusing on innovation trends in areas such as large models, AI computing power, world models, data & one-brain-multiple-forms, and AI hardware. This marks the eighth year of the GAIR conference and represents another convergence of ideas and calibration of direction by China's AI experts from academia, industry, research, and investment in response to the current technological transformation. Just as ancient explorers sought pearls by venturing into the deep sea with torches to uncover treasures beneath the dragon's chin, the same holds true for the ongoing transformation in the AI large model industry. It is important to note that the current wave of AI large models has transitioned from the "technological breakthrough" phase of a few years ago to the "value-deepening" stage, increasingly resembling the treasures beneath the deep-sea dragon's chin—unattainable to those who linger in shallow waters. Since its inception in 2016, the GAIR conference has served as this exploratory torch, deepening its impact over eight years, passing the flame from one generation to the next, and gathering the top minds of forward-looking scholars and industry pioneers. It has illuminated the arduous journey of global AI practitioners and the vast expedition from the budding to the flourishing of the intelligent era. excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de diciembre, Shenzhen, junto con miles de ciudades en el mundo, se encuentra en la víspera del amanecer de la explosión de la industria inteligente, mientras que una reunión de ideas que reúne perspectivas de vanguardia está emergiendo aquí. En el punto crucial donde la tecnología de modelos grandes se adentra en la "transformación industrial", se celebra oficialmente la octava Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) en el Sheraton Shenzhen Bo Lin Tian Rui Hotel. El evento incluye cuatro foros temáticos y dos reuniones a puerta cerrada, centrándose en las innovaciones en áreas como modelos grandes, potencia computacional de IA, modelos mundiales, datos y múltiples formas de un cerebro, y hardware de IA. Este es el octavo año de la conferencia GAIR y representa la reflexión colectiva de expertos chinos en investigación, educación, industria e inversión en IA sobre los cambios tecnológicos actuales.

excerpt_i18n.en: 2025 marks a pivotal year for large models transitioning from "technological breakthroughs" to "value deepening." Throughout this year, technology and industry are undergoing intricate transformations, resonating in sync and accelerating integration. The disruptions of the future are brewing and surging in the dawn of the AI revolution, gradually unveiling a new world to humanity. In this era's early light, how to cut through the fog, glimpse opportunities, courageously engage, and embrace this vast, diverse, and complex wave of intelligence is becoming a pressing question for every industry pioneer. Since its inception in 2016, the Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference (GAIR) has, over the past nine years, repeatedly stood at the forefront of AI transformation. With forward-looking vision, it has accurately and profoundly grasped the pulse of AI technology, establishing a core bridge for cutting-edge exchanges among academia, industry, research, and investment. As a bellwether in the field of artificial intelligence, previous GAIR conferences have invited multiple Turing Award and Nobel Prize laureates, 50 academicians, 30 chairs of top international AI conferences, over 100 fellows, and more than 500 renowned entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators to gather and discuss AI. This time is no exception. On December 12-13, at the banquet hall on the third floor of the Sheraton Shenzhen Bo'lin Tianrui Hotel, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference will also bring together hundreds of guests and thousands of experts. It will feature four thematic forums and two closed-door meetings, focusing on topics such as large models, AI computing power, world models, data & one-brain-multiple-forms, and AI hardware, to collectively explore AI.
excerpt_i18n.es: 2025 será un año crucial en el que los grandes modelos pasarán de "romper barreras tecnológicas" a "profundizar en el valor". Durante este período, la tecnología y la industria experimentarán cambios complejos, resonando y fusionándose a un ritmo acelerado. Esas disrupciones futuras se están gestando y agitando en el amanecer de la revolución de la IA, abriendo lentamente un nuevo mundo para la humanidad. En este alba de la era, cómo despejar la niebla, vislumbrar oportunidades, adentrarse con valentía y abrazar esta vasta, diversa y compleja ola de inteligencia se está convirtiendo en la pregunta fundamental para cada pionero de la industria. Mientras tanto, la "Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica" (GAIR), iniciada en 2016, se ha situado en múltiples ocasiones a la vanguardia de la transformación de la IA durante los últimos nueve años, ofreciendo una visión prospectiva.

items.raw_excerpt: 每晚 10 点，城市渐入静谧，英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的 “专属写作时间” 才刚刚开启；周末的时光，也早已被她固定分配给了采访与写作。 这份坚持，源于一直在坚持做的 “石麻笔记”，最初她只是想随手记录工作中接触的技术信息，未曾想，石麻笔记受到了越来越多业内人士的关注，也在潜移默化中改变着她对机器人行业的认知。 早在具身智能成为资本热词之前，英诺王建明就已经踏入机器人赛道。据科技产业投资平台华芯资本统计，在一级市场，2025 年前七个月，具身智能行业总融资金额超过 300 亿元，在 2024 年上半年，这个数字还只是 75 亿元。资本狂欢的背后，却难掩数据困境。 从 2017 年到现在的 2025 年，她几乎见证了这个行业从默默无闻到名扬世界，也比任何人都清楚，若数据难题不解决，再高的融资额也难以支撑行业走得长远。 英诺王建明坦言：“机器人的数据问题如果不被解决的话，具身行业用现在的范式不一定做得通。” 以下是 AI 科技评论与王建明的对话，AI 科技评论对其进行了不改原意的编辑： 01 只是想要记录而已 AI科技评论：最开始做石麻笔记有遇到困难吗？怎么解决的？ 王建明： 没遇到什么困难，因为非常随性，叫“笔记”其实就是因为这只是工作或学习过程的记录，没有什么期待，所以没有什么困难。 AI科技评论：有给自己规定访谈or写作计划吗? 王建明： 没有，完全是随性随机的，我自己有空并且是感兴趣的话题就会想一下，写一下。 AI科技评论：石麻笔记的文章既有专业深度又能让技术小白看懂，您是怎么把握这个平衡的？ 王建明： 我会从我看论文所产生的问题去发问，因为我自己也不是学术背景，也不会问非常专业的问题，而是从比较容易理解这个工作的点来问的，所以问题比较通俗，受访者的回答也会比较照顾我，会简单的解释一些专业问题，因此写出来的内容对于非技术背景也比较容易消化。 AI科技评论：为什么从投资人

excerpt_i18n.en: At 10 p.m. each night, as the city gradually quiets down, Wang Jianming, ED of Inno Angel Fund, begins her dedicated writing time; weekends are already firmly allocated to interviews and writing. This persistence stems from her ongoing "Shima Notes." Initially, she merely wanted to casually record technical information encountered at work, never expecting that Shima Notes would gain increasing attention from industry insiders and subtly reshape her understanding of the robotics sector. Long before embodied intelligence became a buzzword in capital circles, Inno's Wang Jianming had already entered the robotics track. According to statistics from the technology industry investment platform Huaxin Capital, in the primary market, the total financing amount for the embodied intelligence industry exceeded 30 billion yuan in the first seven months of 2025, whereas in the first half of 2024, this figure was only 7.5 billion yuan. Behind the capital frenzy, however, data challenges remain difficult to conceal. From 2017 to the present year of 2025, she has almost witnessed the industry's rise from obscurity to global prominence and understands better than anyone that without solving data issues, even the highest financing amounts cannot sustain the industry's long-term growth. Wang Jianming frankly states: "If the data problems of robots are not resolved, the embodied industry may not succeed with the current paradigm." Esta perseverancia surge de su constante "Notas de Shima", que comenzó como un simple registro de información técnica en su trabajo, sin imaginar que ganaría cada vez más atención dentro del sector y transformaría gradualmente su visión de la industria robótica.
